note: Kyrgyzstan: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for the stays shown (180 in 360 for the Gulf, 90 in 180 for most of the former Soviet states and Türkiye, 30 in 60 for the EU, North America and others); citizens of every other country may apply for an e-Visa (30 or 60 days); Kosovo's citizens are refused. Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Kyrgyzstan
sources.said: Holders of ordinary passports of the following countries and territories may enter Kyrgyzstan without a visa for the following period: 180 days within any 360 days Bahrain Kuwait Oman Qatar Saudi Arabia United Arab Emirates 90 days within any 180 days Armenia Belarus Kazakhstan Mongolia Russia Serbia Turkey Ukraine 60 days within any 120 days Azerbaijan Georgia Moldova Tajikistan Uzbekistan 30 days within any 60 days All European Union member states Albania Andorra Argentina Australia Bosnia and Herzegovina Brazil Brunei Canada Chile Iceland Israel Japan Liechtenstein North Macedonia Mexico Monaco Montenegro New Zealand Norway San Marino Singapore South Korea Switzerland Thailand United Kingdom United States Vatican City Vietnam 30 days Hong Kong Macau Malaysia Maldives ... From 1 September 2017, citizens of all countries and territories may apply for a business, tourist or group tourist visa valid for 30 or 60 days through the e-Visa system. ... Entry and transit is refused to citizens of Kosovo
